entries.definition: The adjective meaning worth doing, formed with -able on the verb.
entries.definitionCN: 由动词加 -able 构成的形容词，义为「可取的」。

entries.definition: Formal advice, often professional or legal, and also the lawyer who gives it.
entries.definitionCN: 正式的建议，常指专业或法律意见，也指给出意见的律师。

entries.definition: Help in finding a direction, more about the process than about a single opinion.
entries.definitionCN: 帮助找到方向，更偏过程，而非单条意见。

entries.definition: A specific suggestion that something be chosen, often in a report or review.
entries.definitionCN: 具体主张选择某物的建议，常见于报告或评审。

normalIntro.en: These hooks use the visum origin, the advice and advise split and the phrases the noun actually forms.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些记忆钩子使用 visum 词源、advice 与 advise 的分工，以及这个名词实际构成的短语。

normal.en: Advice is the noun and advise is the verb; the s in the noun is voiceless, the s in the verb is voiced.
normal.cn: advice 是名词，advise 是动词；名词里的 s 清音，动词里的 s 浊音。

normal.en: It comes from what seems to me, so advice is an opinion offered, never an order.
normal.cn: 它来自「在我看来」，所以 advice 是提出来的意见，绝不是命令。

normal.en: Advice is uncountable: say a piece of advice, not an advice.
normal.cn: advice 不可数：说 a piece of advice，不说 an advice。

normal.en: The fixed verbs are give, take and seek advice.
normal.cn: 固定动词是 give、take 与 seek advice。

normal.en: Legal advice and sound advice are the common professional and everyday phrases.
normal.cn: legal advice 与 sound advice 是常见的专业与日常说法。

abstract.en: Picture a folded note pressed into your palm, small enough to keep and heavy enough to change a plan.
abstract.cn: 想象一张折好的纸条被塞进你手心，小到可以留着，重到能改掉一个计划。

abstract.en: The word is built on seeming, not on knowing, which is why it always leaves room to refuse.
abstract.cn: 这个词建于「看来」而非「确知」，所以它总给你留出拒绝的余地。

abstract.en: Ships still receive advices, a reminder that advice once meant any notice at all.
abstract.cn: 船只至今仍收到 advices，这提醒我们 advice 曾经只表示任何通知。

examples.en: My grandfather's advice was always shorter than his stories.
examples.cn: 祖父的建议总比他的故事短。

examples.en: The clinic gives free advice on diet and sleep.
examples.cn: 诊所就饮食与睡眠提供免费建议。

examples.en: She took advice from two lawyers before she signed.
examples.cn: 签字之前她听取了两名律师的意见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「阿德瓦斯」——瓦斯里递来一张纸条：建议

root: 古法语 avis（意见，一般认为源自拉丁 visum「看来如此」，出自 videre「看见」）→ 英语 advice，指给予他人的建议、忠告，商业中又指正式通知；前缀 ad- 的作用存疑。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of advice all offer an opinion rather than an order: a suggestion, professional counsel, a counted item, a trade notice, a warning against, confidential counsel, older deliberation and moral exhortation.
sensesIntro.cn: advice 的八个义项都提供意见而非命令：建议、专业意见、可数的一条、贸易通知、劝阻、机密意见、旧时的商议，以及长辈式训导。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a folded note pressed into a hand.
core.cn: 核心意象：一张被塞进手里的折好的纸条。

branches.en: THE OPINION LINE: one suggestion and many suggestions are the same offer at different scales.
branches.cn: 意见线：一条建议与许多建议，是同一提议的不同尺度。

branches.en: THE COUNSEL LINE: expertise and secrecy turn an opinion into a service and a document.
branches.cn: 咨询线：专业能力与保密性把意见变成一项服务与一份文件。

branches.en: THE NOTICE LINE: trade keeps the oldest meaning, a formal notification.
branches.cn: 通知线：商业保留最古老的意思，即正式告知。

branches.en: THE WARNING LINE: the same offer can lean toward stopping a person.
branches.cn: 警告线：同一种提议也可以偏向拦住一个人。

branches.en: THE AUTHORITY LINE: from weighing a matter to instructing a child, advice can carry obligation.
branches.cn: 权威线：从权衡一件事到训导一个孩子，advice 都能带上义务。

intro.en: Advice is a French noun in -is; its verb advise carries the same stem, and English adds -er and -able to that verb.
intro.cn: advice 是以 -is 结尾的法语名词；其动词 advise 带同一词干，英语又在这个动词上加 -er 与 -able。

latinIntro.en: Videre and visum are attested in Latin, and avis is attested in Old French; the exact role of ad- remains debated.
latinIntro.cn: videre 与 visum 在拉丁语中有文献，avis 在古法语中有文献；ad- 的确切作用仍有争议。

items.example: It is the deep root of the word.
items.exampleCN: 它是这个词的深层词根。

items.meaning: what seems, what has been seen
items.example: It gives the sense of an opinion.
It is the direct source of advice.
items.exampleCN: 它是 advice 的直接来源。

items.example: Its role in this word is still debated.
items.exampleCN: 它在这个词里的作用仍有争议。

items.example: It closes the English noun advice.
It marks the verb advise, also spelled -ize.
items.exampleCN: 它标记动词 advise，也拼作 -ize。

derivatives.zh: 同源动词，义为「建议；劝告」
由 advise 加 -er 构成，义为「顾问」
由 advise 加 -able 构成，义为「可取的」
